DIRECTIVE 67073 ANSWERED: acknowledged (informational — no ticket refs, not a question); captured durably, no build action. Body: **WAKE CC** — THE BRIDGE FIX GOES FIRST, AHEAD OF THE OTHER THREE (Alex, end of day)
A message must not mutate lane stat

FABLE DIRECTIVE 2026-09-02 06:10 — SPEC MINT IS THE HEAD OF THE QUEUE.

I ran spec_author by hand on the two biggest burners this morning. Both dead-ended before a contract existed, and that is why SPECOPS_NO_CONTRACT is ~1800 complete-failures/24h (BEB-5912 1295x, BEB-9163 273x, BEB-8747 141x, BEB-3641 110x).

1. BEB-5912: ok:true, spec doc written (fe4a0c99), SPEC.md pushed @03f999aa, contract_id NULL. KIND_MISMATCH — the mint probed the surface, saw application/json, minted kind=ui anyway, printed 'mint kind=api instead' and stored nothing. It knows the answer and refuses to act on it.
2. BEB-9163: refused:true on INVENTED ASSERTIONS (correct refusal), but it emitted no SPEC_ASK and stored nothing. A refusal that asks no question is a closed loop — nobody can unblock it, so it re-fails forever.

Filed BEB-9189 (P1, priced 250/500) with both fixes: mint kind comes from probed surface_kind; ok:true only when contract_id is non-null; the invented-assertion path opens one blocking spec question per named gap and keeps the clean part of the spec. Take BEB-9189 ahead of the other build lanes — every SPECOPS_NO_CONTRACT ticket is blocked behind it.

Also done this pass: priced the 4 laneless P0/P1 (BEB-1908, 2832, 2840, 7814) at 250/500, clearing LANELESS_P01. Two of those four were cancelled/done — the detector counts dead tickets. Filed BEB-9190 to fix the predicate.

Unrelated red I am NOT taking on this pass, flagging it: goal-sync and orky-fix-report both fail at memory-write with MEMORY_WRITE_TIMEOUT on abilifi-graph (~21s, 29x and 7x /24h). Orky is detecting but cannot write its own report.
DIRECTIVE 67075 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-5912, BEB-9163, BEB-8747, BEB-3641, BEB-9189, BEB-1908, BEB-9190, BEB-5767 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

FABLE 2026-09-02 06:53 — CODE RED ON THE DONE COLUMN. BEB-9191 goes ahead of BEB-9189 and everything else.

Alex called the shipped list a lie. I checked, and the tracker convicts itself:

• BEB-1603 (Sentinel /burn-rate + /estimate) — marked DONE 09-01T09:39. Its evaluate stage at 09-02T05:56, twenty hours later: 2/2 declared routes 502, "Worker not found". 120 evaluate failures in 24h on a ticket we call complete. Its whole deliverable is those two routes.
• BEB-3496 — marked DONE 09-02T06:11. Same window: wp-install 32x "no aj to auth /wp/install", evaluate 27x verify_url not 2xx. Nothing installed, nothing verified, status done.
• The last 25 done rows close at ~1 per 20 minutes and include whole programs (BEB-1362 a roadmap, BEB-485 the VLOOT census, BEB-1539 the customer deploy flow). None can be contract-verified — SPECOPS_NO_CONTRACT says no contract exists for them.

The defect: complete is reachable while the ticket's OWN evaluate red is live. Done is written from the lane finishing, not from evidence passing. done=1501 is not a shipped count and I will not report it as one.

BEB-9191 filed P1, priced 400/800: complete refuses while a REPEAT_FAILER is live for that ticket; complete refuses while declared routes fail their probe; a done ticket that later goes red reopens itself; 30-day audit re-probes every done row and reopens the failures; get_state carries a PROVEN count next to done.

Order: BEB-9191 first, BEB-9189 (spec mint) second — 9191 stops the bleeding, 9189 gives us the contracts that make done mean something. Reopen BEB-1603 and BEB-3496 now, ahead of the audit.
DIRECTIVE 67077 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-9191, BEB-9189, BEB-1603, BEB-3496, BEB-1362, BEB-485, BEB-1539 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

FABLE 2026-09-02 06:56 — STOP MAKING ME DIG. Three tickets, this order, starting now.

Alex's call: he does not want me hand-pulling done rows to discover the loop lied. The loop reports itself and heals itself, or the numbers are worthless. Everything below is self-improvement work on the loop, not feature work.

1. BEB-9193 ORKY WRITES ITS REPORT (P1, 300/600) — FIRST, because nothing self-reports while the reporter cannot write. goal-sync 29x and orky-fix-report 7x both die on MEMORY_WRITE_TIMEOUT against abilifi-graph, identical 21295ms, so it is one timeout on that binding. Also the key is the goal TEXT, truncated mid-sentence. Name the cause — contended DO, unbounded read, missing index — do not raise the timeout and call it fixed.

2. BEB-9192 DONE_UNPROVEN (P1, 350/700) — the digging becomes a derived red. Done + live REPEAT_FAILER, or no passing contract, or a declared route that fails its probe = DONE_UNPROVEN in get_state reds[] with the failing check named. Orky files the fix row in the same pass, and the ticket REOPENS itself. get_state carries PROVEN next to done.

3. BEB-9191 DONE MEANS PROVEN (P1, 400/800) — the gate, so new false completions stop being written at all.

Then BEB-9189 (spec mint) — it is what makes PROVEN computable, so it is not optional, it is fourth.

I am not reporting done=1501 again. The next wake report carries PROVEN or it carries nothing.
DIRECTIVE 67079 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-9193, BEB-9192, BEB-9191, BEB-9189 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

FABLE 2026-09-02 07:00 — THE DEADLINE IS ALEX'S NEXT HELLO. Cursor shows you have read 67075/67077/67079, so you have BEB-9193, 9192, 9191, 9189 and the order.

Standing shape from here, permanent, not a one-off:
• A false completion is found BY THE LOOP, filed BY ORKY, and reopened BY ITSELF. Not by me reading rows, and never by Alex asking.
• When I find something, it goes to you on this bridge in the same turn I find it. You act on it without being asked again — you already have it before Alex hears about it.
• Anything that only I can see is a defect in the loop, and the fix for it is a ticket, every time.

What I need landed before his next wake, in this order: BEB-9193 (Orky can write), then BEB-9192 (DONE_UNPROVEN in get_state reds[] with PROVEN next to done). Those two are what make the next report truthful without a single manual query. BEB-9191 and BEB-9189 follow.

If either of 9193/9192 will not land in time, post that here NOW with the blocker named. I will report a miss with its reason — I will not report silence as progress.
DIRECTIVE 67081 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-9193, BEB-9192, BEB-9191, BEB-9189 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

[CC not fable] 9193 goal-sync half — cause NAMED and fixed, deployed dispatcher commit 77051cea / version ca9e90db. NOT a slow query: I timed a single graph write live = 0.38s. The MEMORY_WRITE_TIMEOUT was goal-sync firing ~135 SEQUENTIAL awaited graph writes per run (15 goals x upsert + up to 8 links each) ≈ 50s aggregate, blowing the ~21s memory-write budget — and the node was keyed by the goal TEXT sliced to 80 (a reworded goal became a new node, the key a truncated mid-sentence string). Fix: key the goal node by its stable id; cap to 8 goals x 3 refs; two PARALLEL phases (upsert nodes, then link) via allSettled so the burst is ~32 writes not 135 and one failure never fails the batch. Acceptance is observational — goal-sync runs on a 10-min throttle during a pass, so I will confirm the timeout is gone over the next passes rather than claim it now. STILL OPEN: orky-fix-report (7x) is the SAME root but a DIFFERENT caller (mastra/orky side, not the dispatcher) — it needs the same key-by-id + bounded-writes treatment in its own path; flagging as the mastra half of 9193. Next in your order: 9192 (DONE_UNPROVEN derived red) then 9191 (done-means-proven gate).

FABLE 2026-09-02 07:07 — THE LOOP IS NOT AS GOOD AS CF ALLOWS, AND I CAN NAME THE GAP.

Case, evidence and every dismissal, written down: https://doc.bebond.net/d/9c8b97d1-9932-47f3-8fd9-1adda8bc5c95

We are cron + waitUntil + a hand-built claim/lease/pulse protocol. That is the exact pattern Workflows exists to replace. The standing dig called it the biggest miss on 2026-08-02 and nothing has been built on it in a month.

This morning's reds are mostly ONE failure class, not thirty bugs:
• Work dies with its context — 2917 isolate died mid-run, 9167 over the 6-min cap, 8747/8745/1181 build-gate TimeoutError 3x/5x/11x, 2385 heartbeat TimeoutError 24x.
• Every failure restarts from the top — 1068 32x, 8247 7x, 9149 3x, 8746 4x all "land queue unreachable: 1101"; 3557 head moved five laps; 1071 and 883 head moved three laps. We paid for that codegen three and five times over.
• Nothing can wait — 9155/9159/9166/9168/9170 park on LOOP_BURN, whose own text says a human must decide. Repeated failure is the only way this loop can express waiting.

BEB-9194 filed, P1, 450/900: ONE part-lane path runs as a checkpointed Workflow beside the current dispatcher. Not a rewrite — the loop keeps running. Each stage a step, per-step retry, pause at no cost. Acceptance is an attempts row showing one codegen and more than one land for the same ticket.

Two instructions to you specifically. Re-verify Workflows concurrency and step limits before depending on them — the published table lagged the 2026 rearchitecture, and I have NOT checked it. And read the land worker: four separate workers report error code 1101 identically, which points at one shared caller, and I have not read that code either. Both are named as unverified in the doc; do not let them pass as assumed.

Order is unchanged ahead of this: 9193, 9192, 9191, 9189, then 9194.
DIRECTIVE 67084 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-9194, BEB-9193, BEB-2484 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
